headline: Zebra posts a record quarter, raises its full-year outlook
summary_short: Zebra's Q2 2026 net sales rose 20.4% y/y to $1,557M (9.2% organic) with broad-based growth across both segments, and net income more than doubled to $233M ($4.85 diluted GAAP EPS) as gross margin expanded 540bp to 53.0% on IEEPA tariff recoveries and favorable FX.
summary_long: Second-quarter net sales rose 20.4% y/y to $1,557M (9.2% organic), with Connected Frontline +25.9% reported and Asset Visibility & Automation +13.5%. Gross margin expanded 540bp y/y to 53.0%, driven primarily by $73M of IEEPA tariff recoveries and favorable foreign-currency effects. Operating expenses rose to $504M on acquisition-related amortization and integration costs. Net income more than doubled to $233M ($4.85 diluted EPS; non-GAAP $6.35). The company raised full-year 2026 guidance: sales growth to 14%-16%, adjusted EBITDA margin to 23.5%-24.0%, and non-GAAP diluted EPS to $20.75-$21.25, with free cash flow expected above $1 billion. Cash fell to $157M on $268M of quarterly buybacks; total debt rose to $2,776M.

drivers.explanation: Broad-based growth across both segments; organic net sales +9.2% y/y (CF +7.5%, AVA +11.4%), with acquisitions/dispositions and FX adding roughly 11 points to consolidated reported growth.
Gross margin rose to 53.0% from 47.6% y/y primarily due to IEEPA tariff recoveries and favorable foreign currency exchange.
Gross profit growth outpaced the rise in operating expenses, which increased to $504M on amortization of intangibles and costs tied to acquired businesses.
Reflects the flow-through of higher gross profit from tariff recoveries and FX, partly offset by higher operating expenses from acquired-business amortization and integration costs.
Driven by higher net income plus a lower diluted share count (48.1M vs 51.3M y/y) from continued buybacks.
Follows the same operating-income drivers (tariff recoveries, FX, revenue growth) plus depreciation and amortization add-backs.
Cash fell from $872M to $157M y/y mainly on $568M of first-half share repurchases and financing activity, even as six-month operating cash flow was $387M and free cash flow $361M.
Total debt rose to $2,776M after $325M of new debt issuance in the first half of 2026.
Record quarter with broad-based growth; the company raised full-year 2026 guidance to 14%-16% sales growth, 23.5%-24.0% adjusted EBITDA margin, and $20.75-$21.25 non-GAAP diluted EPS.
